insight.heart-demon-vanquisher.why: Charmed and Frightened save Advantage stays in this defense row; insights3 seals the other printed categories and the paid Reaction reroll.

insight.legacy-iron-bones.outcome: Resistance to Bludgeoning damage; when another source also gives you Bludgeoning Resistance, each time you take Bludgeoning damage reduce it by your Proficiency Bonus

insight.legacy-soul-ward.why: Only the explicit reviewed clauses are automated. Other printed clauses remain visible riders.

insight.lightning-scarred-meridians.outcome: Resistance to Lightning damage; once per round regain 1 Qi after hostile Lightning damage, or, when another source also gives you Lightning Resistance, reduce the first Lightning damage you take each round by your Proficiency Bonus instead
